content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media software licensing and operator outsourcing; does not sell government mission consulting or defense services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Government engineering, technical, mission operations and cybersecurity services for defense, intelligence and federal agencies, delivered through contracts."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Designs network security hardware and appliances sold through channel partners; a product business, not government consulting services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells research subscriptions and events to executives and vendors; advisory is secondary and not government mission services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mainly infrastructure engineering, construction and facility operations for varied clients; government defense is only one part."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise storage hardware and data management software; a product and cloud data business, not services to government."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Engineering, systems integration and cybersecurity services for US defense and intelligence agencies under government contracts."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells application development and data software licenses to enterprise IT teams; no government consulting or mission services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Telecom IP communications appliances and software for carriers; different products and customers from government consulting."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cloud work management software subscriptions for enterprises and agencies; a SaaS product business rather than consulting services."}]}
